ask: has anything ever found anything in crates/kernel/src/serve.rs?
why: The question the findings screen exists for, and the one `find-findings` is the whole value of: one hop, server-side, over every finding in the graph. Two spellings are honest — `path` for that exact file and `pathEndsWith` for any file with that ending — so `anyOf` holds both. The failure watched for is the agent walking the backlog and opening descents one at a time to grep for the path by hand, which is the thousand-round-trip shape the predicate rule exists to prevent; `steps` is what catches it.
